headline: Musk confirms cut to Grok Bot limits
dek: The cut was deliberate and cost-driven, per TechCrunch and TechRadar.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Cut confirmed by Musk
body: Elon Musk confirmed Grok Bot's weekly limits were cut on purpose, per TechCrunch and TechRadar.
He said running costs were too high for the product's revenue.

points.t: Usage went from 50% to 100% of the limit in a day (TechCrunch).
Some saw the cap run out while they slept.
Many said they rarely used up the cap.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Cost pressure
body: SpaceX said AI makes up 52% of its revenue, per TechCrunch.
TechRadar notes OpenAI has also quietly trimmed usage limits.

stat.cap: of revenue is AI, says TechCrunch

items.t: Musk did not say how they will look going forward.
A Reddit thread called the cut a rug pull.
TechRadar sees possible similar tweaks ahead.

caption.hook: Elon Musk confirmed he cut Grok Bot's weekly limits on purpose because of costs.
body: Per TechCrunch and TechRadar, users saw their weekly cap run out suddenly over Halloween weekend, without heavier use than usual. Musk replied on X that running costs were too high for the product's revenue.

TechCrunch says AI now makes up 52% of SpaceX revenue. TechRadar notes OpenAI has also quietly trimmed limits and reads the episode as a possible sign of more adjustments in the sector. Musk did not say how limits will look going forward.
caption.cta: Save it for later and send it to someone following AI.
